standard.summary: 概念编辑的算法路线：ileco（默认，基于 caption 的概念方向学习）或 addift（基于成对图像的潜空间差分学习）。
standard.effect: ileco 用 target_prompt 等文本对驱动，target_prompt 留空时偏向擦除原概念；addift 需要 original/target 成对图像（数据集按 original_ 前缀配对），学习两张图之间的变化方向。数据集加载器按方法校验样本结构，不支持的取值直接报错。
standard.whenToUse: 想「让某个词的语义改变/消失」用 iLECO（改笑容、擦水印概念等）；有明确的前后对比图（同一构图改了某个元素）想学这种变换用 ADDifT。
standard.avoidWhen: ADDifT 没有像素级对应的成对图时效果差（建议同分辨率、同构图）；iLECO 的 prompt 对写不清楚概念边界时学到的方向会含糊。

standard_en.summary: The concept-editing algorithm: ileco (the default, caption-based concept direction learning) or addift (latent-space difference learning from paired images).
standard_en.effect: ileco is driven by text pairs such as target_prompt; leaving target_prompt empty leans towards erasing the original concept. addift needs original/target image pairs (the dataset pairs them by the original_ prefix) and learns the direction of change between the two. The dataset loader validates sample structure per method, and an unsupported value is an outright error.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use iLECO when you want a word's meaning changed or removed (altering a smile, erasing a watermark concept); use ADDifT when you have explicit before/after images (the same composition with one element changed) and want that transformation learned.
standard_en.avoidWhen: ADDifT does poorly without pixel-level correspondence between the pairs (same resolution and composition is best); iLECO learns a vague direction when the prompt pair does not draw the concept boundary clearly.

advanced.principle: iLECO：在文本条件空间构造正负概念对，训练 LoRA 让模型对原概念的预测靠近目标概念的预测，本质是语义方向编辑。ADDifT：对成对图像的 latent 做差分监督，LoRA 学习 original→target 的潜空间位移，适合可视化定义的变化。
advanced.intervention: trainer_side_train_runtime.py：method 解析后传入 ConceptEditDataset（concept_edit_dataset.py 按 ileco/addift 决定样本配对方式：addift 额外加载 original_<stem> 图像，ileco 用 caption 对）；每步回调把 method 写入训练指标。
advanced.expectedImpact: iLECO 常见 300~1000 步；ADDifT 收敛快（30~150 步），步数超配容易过拟合差分方向。
advanced.tradeoffs: 两种方法的产物都是「编辑向量式 LoRA」，适合低权重叠加使用而不是当作常规角色/风格 LoRA。
advanced.codePath: trainer_side_train_runtime.py：method 分支；concept_edit_dataset.py：按方法配对样本（不支持值抛 ValueError）；concept_edit_anima_mixin.py：ileco/addift batch 处理

advanced_en.principle: iLECO: builds positive/negative concept pairs in text-conditioning space and trains a LoRA so the model's prediction for the original concept moves toward the target concept's prediction — essentially semantic-direction editing. ADDifT: applies difference supervision on latents of paired images; the LoRA learns the original→target latent-space displacement, suited to visually defined changes.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_side_train_runtime.py: after method is parsed it is passed to ConceptEditDataset (concept_edit_dataset.py decides sample pairing by ileco/addift: addift additionally loads original_<stem> images, ileco uses caption pairs); a per-step callback writes the method into training metrics.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: iLECO commonly needs 300~1000 steps; ADDifT converges fast (30~150 steps), and over-allocating steps easily overfits the difference direction.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Both methods produce an "edit-vector-style LoRA", suited to stacking at low weights rather than serving as a regular character/style LoRA.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer_side_train_runtime.py: method branching; concept_edit_dataset.py: pairs samples by method (unsupported values raise ValueError); concept_edit_anima_mixin.py: ileco/addift batch handling
